2. The science is pretty clear from what I read in the Times and hear from Democratic leaders - human activity is the main driver of climate change and we need policy action. | B

3. Everything I see from progressive sources shows fossil fuel companies knew about climate change for decades and covered it up while buying off politicians - human activity is definitely the major cause. | B

4. NPR consistently covers the scientific consensus and Democratic officials I trust emphasize human responsibility for climate change, so I believe the evidence is strong. | B

5. All the progressive content I follow makes it crystal clear that fossil fuel emissions are driving the climate crisis - the science is settled and corporate interests are blocking solutions. | B
